notes.title: Egglets: The Long 10 Days - Demo Now Playable! 🥚
notes.content:
The Demo Has Arrived!
Experience the first three days of The Long 10 Days storyline in this demo. 

Step into the role of the Administrator in Eggon Planet, meet the egglets, and begin your journey! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650032/116f832cf6d2539f7bd03c296ae872f301f2b417.png"]

Try it now and share your feedback with us! ☺️
